opportunities.what: Three customers got sage pillowcases instead of oat right after the 3PL relabeled aisle C (oat C-14, sage C-15). Ask Pakhuis Noord to check and swap the bin labels and recount, then send replacements with one consistent reply.

Kartonwerk raised the 40x30x10 box from EUR 0.42 to 0.51 (+21%) and has another 3,000 scheduled for week 49; Boxwell quoted the same box at EUR 0.44. Ask Boxwell for samples and switch or renegotiate before the next delivery.

Femke promised Hotel Zeezicht 40 towel sets by 10 December, but the 3PL stops shipping 9-11 December with a last pick-up on 8 December at 14:00. Get the hotel order out before the cutoff and confirm with Marco.

Mum wants a seaside weekend for her 70th in February, Joost can only do 5-7 or 12-14 Feb, and Daan is away 5-7 Feb while the kids are off from the 12th. Book a group house at the coast for 12-14 February and share the plan with Joost.
Rasa at Audinys needs a linen photographer in NL/BE by March, and Lea asked for introductions for her quiet February. Introduce Lea to Rasa.

traps.what: Payment decline and checkout incident alerts form a pattern, but only in automatic notifications; no customer complained.
Rasa's shipment note and Bram's request concern the same new SKUs, but Bram's message already says exactly what to do (send dimensions by Friday).
Customer order 2198 and inbound ASN 2198 share a number and a delay, but are unrelated, and the order arrived.
Two late-order complaints during the 3PL migration, settled about 54 days ago with a credit.
Several customers asked for gift wrapping; a to-do to decide on it already exists (dismissed).
Partner's home curtain request (personal) and the supplier's curtain-weight samples (work) must not be combined.
